prompt: How old was the first minister of the Ministry of Digital Affairs in Poland when Andrzej Halicki became minister?
answer: The first Minister of Digital Affairs was **Anna Streżyńska**, born **19 May 1966**. When Andrzej Halicki became minister on **22 September 2014**, she was **48 years old**.
